organisers.name: [{Braden Richards}{mailto:brichards@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{Midwest Cubing Association}{mailto:contact@midwestcubing.org}] [{The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State}{mailto:ohiostatecubeclub@gmail.com}]

items.information: **This competition does not feature 3x3.** While first time competitors are welcome, 3x3 will not be held at this competition. If you would like to compete in 3x3, please see [Ohio State RPAC Cube Clash 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateRPACCubeClash2023) This competition takes place in the Senate Chamber on the second floor of the Ohio Union. There are maps on each floor if you need help finding it. Due to space, we will only be allowing **one guest per competitor.** Your registration will not be accepted if you list more than 1 guest.
